Subject: Implementation MAP — Crestfall Health: Kickoff & Canary Window

Hi Sanjay / Laura —

Congrats again on the signature — attaching the MAP snapshot (MAP_v1.2.xlsx) and the evaluation prompt set we plan to use (eval_prompt_set_v3.csv). I embedded the post-signature implementation plan so you can see how rollout, canary, migration, and training tie to milestones. High-level proposal: 

- Phase 0 (Week 0): Contract & SOW uploaded (complete) — finalize environment access and service accounts.
- Phase 1 (Week 1–2): Canary cohort (5% traffic, two customer org units) — 48–72 hour stabilization window, continuous eval checks.
- Phase 2 (Week 3–4): Expanded rollout (25% → 75%) with staged model pinning and KV cache priming.
- Phase 3 (Week 5): Full cutover and knowledge-transfer training sessions for ops & support.

Evaluation plan (see eval_prompt_set_v3.csv): daily regression tests for 10 canonical prompts, quality thresholds, and automated alerting if mean-pass-rate drops below 92%. Canary gating: if latency P95 increases by >40% or error-rate >1.5% for 2 consecutive windows, we pause and rollback to the previous model variant.

Specific asks:
1) Please confirm the canary cohort (we proposed: Claims Team + Billing).
2) Confirm stakeholder for weekly checkpoint (we suggested: Laura + Sanjay).
3) Sign-off on MAP_v1.2.xlsx and the eval prompt set so we can lock training dates.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP_v1.2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 48KB)], [Attachment: eval_prompt_set_v3.csv (text/csv, 12KB)]

I can run the first training block on Sep 20–21 if those dates work — we planned two 90-min sessions (Ops deep-dive, Support Q&A).

Sanjay / Laura —

Quick operational clarification on canary gating and metrics so everyone is aligned before sign-off: 

- Canary cohort size: start with a single Claims workspace (~3k daily calls) for 48 hours, then expand only if both quality and infra metrics pass.
- Acceptance gates (we'll automate checks):
  * Quality: daily pass-rate >= 92% on the eval prompts.
  * Latency: median token latency within 1.15x baseline; P95 < 350ms for the canary traffic slice.
  * Errors: API error-rate < 0.8% (5xx + 429 aggregated).
- Rollback policy: automatic rollback if any gate violates threshold for 2 consecutive 1-hour windows or if infra-side alerts (GPU memory OOM or sustained queue growth) trigger.

I'll attach a short runbook and the proposed rollback command set when we lock the time — temporary attachment stub below.

[Attachment: deployment_diagram.png (image/png, 24KB)]

If that looks good, Vanessa — can we push the training split per Sanjay's note and schedule the Ops deep-dive on Sep 20 and Support Q&A on Sep 22?
